mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sales_user ( branch_id, employee_id, password_hash, name, birth_date, email, phone, rank_code, role_code, status_code, login_fail_count, is_temp_password, terms_agreed, joined_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{branchId}, #{employeeId}, #{passwordHash}, #{name}, #{birthDate}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{rankCode}, #{roleCode}, #{statusCode}, 0, #{isTempPassword}, #{termsAgreed}, #{joinedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE sales_user SET employee_id = #{employeeId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sales_user SET status_code = #{statusCode}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT ( (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM potential_customer WHERE sales_user_id = #{userId}) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM integrated_customer WHERE sales_user_id = #{userId}) ) AS remaining_customer_count
mapper.update: UPDATE sales_user SET phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_assignment_history ( potential_customer_id, integrated_customer_id, from_sales_user_id, to_sales_user_id, changed_by_user_id, reason, changed_at ) SELECT pc.id, pc.parent_customer_id, pc.sales_user_id, #{toUserId}, #{changedByUserId}, #{reason}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM potential_customer pc WHERE pc.sales_user_id = #{fromUserId}
mapper.update: UPDATE potential_customer SET sales_user_id = #{toUserId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE sales_user_id = #{fromUserId}
UPDATE integrated_customer SET sales_user_id = #{toUserId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE sales_user_id = #{fromUserId}
